newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline firmer as crude gets U.S. boost.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline firmer as crude gets U.S. boost.

text.p: Spot gasoline barges on the ARA market traded at firmer levels on Friday but cargo activity in northwest Europe was extremely light, traders said.
Prompt Eurograde (premium unleaded) fetched $221.50 a tonne, basis fob ARA, up $2.50 from the previous reported deal on Tuesday, as crude markets got a boost from U.S. inventory data.

Later barrels were also firmer, talked $1 over January swaps which gained $1 to $216/$218. Other grades and cargo markets were only thinly talked but pegged notionally firmer in line with Eurograde, traders said.
